name: Smooth Motion
description: Generates frames for the display refresh rate or a fixed target frame rate.
info:
Generates frames with mpv's framerate filter (linear blending).
Open Statistics (I), then press its number key (usually 2).
Settings chooses the display refresh rate or a fixed frame rate.
Hardware decoding is paused while interpolation is active: the filter only accepts software frames. The filter is added when the file opens, so playback starts without a hitch.
The on/off shortcut is assigned in Settings → Shortcuts (F9 by default).
settings.mode.label: Frame rate
settings.mode.description: Generates frames to the detected display refresh rate.
settings.interpolation.label: Motion interpolation
settings.interpolation.description: Generate intermediate frames by blending neighbouring frames with the framerate filter. Disable to leave the video at its source rate. Hardware decoding is paused while interpolation is active.
shortcuts.toggle.label: Smooth Motion on / off
stats.title: Smooth Motion stats
status.filterRejected: mpv rejected the filter; see the mpv log
status.filterDisabled: mpv disabled the filter; see the mpv log
